name: Date
summary: Builds a date from a month, day, and year; overflowing values are normalized by the engine.
details: An empty set of inputs produces an empty value.

name: Day
summary: Returns the day number from a date.

name: DayName
summary: Returns the English weekday name for a date.

name: DayOfWeek
summary: Returns the weekday number, with Sunday as 1.

name: DayOfYear
summary: Returns the one-based day position within the date's year.

name: GetAsDate
summary: Converts a value to a date when its contents can be interpreted as one.

name: GetAsTime
summary: Converts a value to a time when its contents can be interpreted as one.

name: GetAsTimestamp
summary: Converts a value to a timestamp when its contents can be interpreted as one.

name: Hour
summary: Returns the hour component of a time as a number.

name: Minute
summary: Returns the minute component of a time as a number.

name: Month
summary: Returns the month number from a date.

name: MonthName
summary: Returns the English month name for a date.

name: Seconds
summary: Returns the seconds component of a time as a number.

name: Time
summary: Builds a time value from hours, minutes, and seconds.

name: Timestamp
summary: Combines a date and time into a timestamp value.

name: WeekOfYear
summary: Returns the week number for a date, counting the week containing January 1 as week 1.

name: WeekOfYearFiscal
summary: Returns a week number using a supplied first weekday and a four-day first-week rule.
details: The engine calculates weeks from its implemented start-day rule; compatibility beyond existing examples is unverified.
differences: The engine implementation uses an ISO-like rule in which the first week has at least four days of the new year.

name: Year
summary: Returns the year number from a date.
